subject: SEND - New legally binding notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your business has received on SEND - Servizio Notifiche Digitali a legally binding notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} with IUN code ${notification.iun}.
body2: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The business has up to 120 days from the finalization date of the SEND notification to access the documents. The deadline for payment, if applicable, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
body3: A legally binding notification consists of a notification of receipt and one or more documents.
perfection: If you access the SEND notification within 5 days of this email being sent, you will avoid registered mail and any related costs.
read_more: SEND is a tool that makes the sending of legally binding notifications by the Public Administration safer, more efficient and cost-effective. Find out more
footer: You are receiving this email because you entered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your address<#else>the company email address as a contact detail on SEND. To modify contact details or add new ones, go to your contact details.
